sentences.text: Midnight saw the house settling, but in the office, a strange warmth with no source began at 01:10.
The thermal anomaly quickly peaked at 01:30, pushing the temperature up to 22.2 °C, far exceeding the predicted range of 21.1 °C to 21.6 °C.
This unexplained warmth lingered for hours, persisting deep into the night.
The ghostly heat in the office finally receded, ending its strange vigil at 04:50.
